title: DynamicDataCapture - Data API
description: DynamicDataCapture is a junction object that adds a Form tab to Work Order Overview, and to the related list of a work order, work order line item, or service appointment in the Field Service mobile app. This object is available in API version 62.0 and later.

ActionDefinition.description: The associated Data Capture Flow to execute.

ActionType.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
ActionType.description: The type of platform action that the form is associated with. Possible values are: Possible values are: Flow The default value is Flow.

Description.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

ExecutionOrder.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ExecutionOrder.description: The order in which the Data Capture flow is executed. Positive integer values or null are supported.

IsRequired.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsRequired.description: Boolean value that specifies if this form needs to be completed before moving on to the next form.

LastReferencedDate.description: The order in which the Data Capture flow is executed. Positive integer values or null are supported.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID that refers to user who owns the Dynamic Data Capture object. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.
OwnerId.refers_to: ServiceAppointment, WorkOrder, WorkOrderLineItem (the parent object), Timesheet

ParentRecordId.description: The ID that refers to a work order, work order line item, or service appointment that serves as the parent record for junction object. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

ParentRecordType.description: The type of parent object associated with the junction object. Possible values are: Work Order Work Order Line Item Service Appointment

PausedFlowInterviewId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PausedFlowInterviewId.description: The ID of the flow interview that has been paused by a user. This field is a relationship field.

ProcessType.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
ProcessType.description: The flow process type for the form. Possible values are: DataCaptureFlow—Data Capture Flow The default value is DataCaptureFlow.

ServiceDocumentTemplate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

ServiceReportLanguage.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update

StatusCategory.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
StatusCategory.description: The category that each status value belongs to. Possible values are: Completed InProgress—In Progress New NotApplicable—Not Applicable Paused The default value is New.

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **DynamicDataCaptureChangeEvent(API Version 64.0)**: Change events are available for the object.
- **DynamicDataCaptureOwnerSharingRule (API Version 64.0)**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **DynamicDataCaptureShare (API Version 64.0)**: Sharing is available for the object.
